<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1108048_wish_l_0.CaseDemoUtils</api_name><caller_access>1</caller_access><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>CaseDemoUtils</name><sandbox_callable>true</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/* global AbstractAjaxProcessor, GlideRecord, JSON, gs */
var CaseDemoUtils = Class.create();
CaseDemoUtils.prototype = Object.extendsObject(AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
  
    searchCaseDemoRecords: function() {
		gs.info("Entering searchCaseDemoRecords method");
        var keyword = this.getParameter('sysparm_keyword');
		gs.info("Received keyword: " + keyword); // 参数日志
        var results = [];
        
        // 使用自定义表名
        var gr = new GlideRecord('x_1108048_wish_l_0_democase');
        
        if (keyword) {
            // 全文搜索，匹配所有可搜索字段
            gr.addQuery('123TEXTQUERY321', keyword);
        }
        gr.addActiveQuery();
        gr.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on');
        gr.setLimit(15);
        gr.query();
        
        while (gr.next()) {
            results.push({
                sys_id: gr.getUniqueValue(),
                number: gr.getDisplayValue('number') || gr.getDisplayValue('u_number'), // 根据实际字段名调整
                title: gr.getDisplayValue('title') || gr.getDisplayValue('u_title'),
                question: gr.getDisplayValue('question') || gr.getDisplayValue('u_question'),
                // 添加其他需要显示的字段
                ask_for: gr.getDisplayValue('ask_for') || gr.getDisplayValue('u_ask_for'),
                ask_from: gr.getDisplayValue('ask_from') || 'N/A'
            });
        }
        
        return JSON.stringify(results);
    },

    type: 'CaseDemoUtils'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-10-10 07:12:57</sys_created_on><sys_id>b5c5867083a43210f23ee270ceaad38b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>7</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CaseDemoUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Wish List" source="x_1108048_wish_l_0">6c3b38c7c30cf210957c1d0ed401318c</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Wish List">6c3b38c7c30cf210957c1d0ed401318c</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_b5c5867083a43210f23ee270ceaad38b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-10-11 10:27:56</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
